confidence_notes: The FX rate is the RBA's 18 November 2026 observation from search results. Food and drink estimates come from one web search of travel blogs and guides, which gave rough INR meal ranges (budget Rs 150-450, mid-range cafes Rs 400-800 per person) and a rough beer price of about Rs 150 (undated, older). No Leh-specific cappuccino, cocktail or wine prices were found. Coffee is based on a generic $2 guide figure, adjusted down. Cocktail and wine are set as multiples of beer, with wine and cocktails priced high because alcohol is scarce and restricted in Leh. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Ladakh. July is peak season, and I did not inspect any live listings. Uncertainty is highest for accommodation and drinks.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Indian Himalayan tourist towns such as Manali and Dharamshala. Leh has a short, high-demand summer season and higher costs because supplies are brought in over long distances.
